dummyHits.note: Per entity action (one attack test of one Phantom_Blade_obj sentry that finds the dummy in range). Blades: N0 = ReturnSentryAmount(90) = 3 + p1.s9 + RSS362 (base 3, not 1; R4 90#0), life 5 s*(1 + p6), the oldest is destroyed at the limit. WITHOUT p11 the blade does NOT orbit: it is created at (x, y) + lengthdir(tupm[6], tupm[7]) = the cursor point (6 px above the cursor, ~30 px from the dummy centre) and the attack condition distance_to_object(nearest enemy) < attackRange (96*(1 + p4), bbox gap) is always true there, so every attack test hits: 1 hit per entity action = one Hitbox_Obj (scale 1.5*(1 + p7)) carrying physical damage[0] = floor(floor(W*(1 + V2%))*(1+LSSD)) and arcane damage[1] in the SAME hit (rule 22: cursor on the visible dummy centre). Cadence (Resztki po R4, C): the range test runs every ceil(60*sF)+1 frames (91 at sF = 1.5 s, sF = max(1.5 - 0.004*sAS, 0.2)), first test at frame 16, independent of the attack; with continuous casting every T_okres(c) = 40 frames (c = 1.85) the attack rate per frame is A(L)/40, A(L) = floor((L - 16)/(ceil(60*sF) + 1)) + 1, L = min(300, N0*40): N0 = 3..8 -> 0.050/0.050/0.075/0.075/0.075/0.100 per frame (was N/91; engine side; continuous casting and kill order are I). p11 orbit (r 64 px, +4 deg/frame) puts the 160 px dummy out of range for p4 <= 2 (see p11/p4 subskill entries). p8 Twice The Price (+0.03r), p12 Terrorized Mind, p14 scimitars (2(r + 1) hits replacing the hitbox hit) are subskill effects; perExtraProjectile = 0.
